features.name: Bark Plate Armor
features.text: When the Timberwolf marks HP from a physical attack, the attacker receives 1d4 damage from razor-sharp splinters

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.text: When a Timberwolf makes an attack and another Wolf is within Melee range of the target the attack deals +3 damage per wolf

features.name: Gnarled Camouflage
features.text: When stationary and hidden, is indistinguishable from a dead tree or brush pile. Players make an Instinct 14 roll to identify. While hidden, the Timberwolf has Advantage on their opening attack

features.name: Desperate Howl
features.text: If a Timberwolf Marks severe damage it releases an eerie wood-creaking howl. Players within very close range make a Presence 14 Reaction, on fail the PC becomes Vulnerable and must spend a Hope to clear

customAdversaries.name: Jagged-Stone Golem
customAdversaries.motive: Guard ancient elemental shrines, crush intruders with pulverized bedrock.

features.name: Ground Stomp
features.text: Spend a Fear to strike the ground. All PCs within Very Close must make an Agility Reaction Roll (15) or take 2d8 physical damage and be knocked Prone.

features.name: Rock Hurl
features.text: Hurl a jagged stone slab at a target within Far range, dealing 2d10+2 physical damage.

features.name: Stonewall Density
features.text: When taking physical damage, reduce the damage taken by 3.

customAdversaries.name: Chasm of Whispers
customAdversaries.motive: A narrow obsidian gorge where trapped winds mimic voices of lost companions.
customAdversaries.impulses: Lure wanderers near unstable ledges; shatter loose rock shelves under foot.

features.name: Echoing Mirage
features.text: When a PC fails an Instinct check, spend a Fear to impose Vulnerable on them as disorienting whispers surround them.

features.name: Crumbling Precipice
features.text: When an adversary or PC takes Severe damage or causes an explosion, a 15-foot section of the cliff collapses. Anyone in the area must make an Agility check (14) or fall to the ledge below taking 1d8 physical damage.

customAdversaries.name: Timberwolf Matriarch
customAdversaries.motive: Isolate the Weak, Vanish into the Fog

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: Terrifying (Passive): When the Matriarch Timberwolf makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and the GM gains a Fear

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Matriarch Timberwolf can be spotlighted up to 2 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight her

features.name: Call of the Mire
features.text: Spend 1 Fear. Thick, unnatural fog rolls across the battlefield. The Matriarch Timberwolf and all allies within Close range of her instantly become Hidden. While the mist persists, all ranged attacks made against targets inside the fog have disadvantage.

features.name: Throned Retaliation
features.text: When a creature within Melee range hits the Matriarch Timberwolf with a physical attack, Mark 1 Stress to cause the attacker to take 1d6 physical damage from her razor-sharp, briar-choked hide

customAdversaries.name: Madamme Veyra

features.name: Fatal
features.text: When the Head is Destroyed, the Colossus is defeated.

features.name: Fatal
features.text: When the Torso is Destroyed, the Colossus is defeated.

features.name: Buck Foes
features.text: Spend a Fear to throw creatures off this segment.

features.name: Seismic Shock
features.text: Spend a Fear to knock grounded foes prone.

customAdversaries.motive: Loom over the battlefield, shatter terrain with titanic force, and demand coordinated climbing tactics to destroy vulnerable segments.

features.name: Colossal Power
features.text: When the colossus fails an attack, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Swatting Pests
features.text: When attacked by a flying target within Far range, make a reaction attack. On success, deal damage and the target is knocked to the ground.
